name: tales_end_counters_activated_ability_soulmender
notes: Printed: 'Counter target activated ability, triggered ability, or legendary spell.' Seat 0 activates Soulmender ({T}: You gain 1 life) and holds; seat 1 answers with Tale's End targeting that activated ability. The ability is countered (CR 701.5a): no life is gained (seat 0 stays at 20), but its cost was already paid, so Soulmender stays tapped.
